summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view.
page_description: A read-only Mealie companion. Pick tonight's recipe and cook one large step at a time, with the screen kept on and the recipe available offline.
release_notes: Connecting Mealie lists the commands to run on your computer, with no address to look up.

steps.text: Create an API token in Mealie's user settings.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Install the token under the name mealie, then add the address in the app.
